What to understand at MT10

Neutral Era disable
The action that disables Neutral’s Era power during a tower test. It has a special role in the discovery at this stage.
Discovery versus unlocking
Finding a stone and completing its later unlock conditions are different steps. This guide focuses on the discovery needed for promotion.

What you are working toward

  • Work toward the documented Era 10,000,000 goal.
  • Complete the special discovery: the supplied research describes disabling Neutral’s Era power at Era 1,000,000 or later. Check that Headquarters actually registers it.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Stabilize your existing Era setup

    Use the divisor and XP process from MT9 until your runs reliably reach the necessary upgrades. Check that the elements in your chosen region do not introduce an unhandled power. A discovery attempt is easier when the underlying run is dependable. [S08]

  2. Research the available acceleration

    Inspect Era Surge and Era Burst and improve available research. Experiment rewards may supply useful Era modules; evaluate them in the context of your actual blueprint rather than automatically replacing everything. [S07] [S08]

  3. Plan the discovery before the counter races past it

    Make sure you understand where the Neutral power control is and how to pay its disable cost. Use a run where you can perform the required action at the relevant Era. Slow or pause the progression process as needed to inspect the condition instead of assuming a fast highscore run will complete it automatically. [S02] [S09]

  4. Perform the action and check the objective

    At Era one million or later, disable Neutral as described in the supplied source. Inspect the discovery or Headquarters objective afterward. If it did not register, read the current condition carefully before spending time on a new full-length push. [S02] [S09]

  5. Finish depth and collection requirements

    Continue to Era ten million, then complete any remaining module objectives. A highscore and a discovery are separate achievements; confirm both before expecting promotion. [S02]

If you are stuck

I reached ten million but promotion is still blocked

Inspect the special-discovery line. A large Era record does not prove you performed the Neutral action.

Do I have to repeat the whole climb?

The supplied research describes revisiting a sufficiently high record with Critical Wavejump. Check your current software behavior and the discovery condition before attempting that recovery route.

Ready to move on?

  • Headquarters confirms the special discovery.
  • The Era and module objectives are all complete.
After the promotion

MT11’s next challenge is the scale of the journey. Build acceleration across the map before trying to brute-force the route to the first Infinity. [S02] [S07] [S09]
